_max_pages_help: Pages of 25 results to scrape per title. 8 pages = 200 results/title. Higher catches more jobs from smaller companies.
_target_locations_help: Only jobs in these cities (or remote) are kept. Use alternate spellings (Bengaluru/Bangalore). An empty array means no location filter.
_yoe_threshold_help: Candidate's years of experience. Jobs requiring 0 to yoe_threshold+1 years are eligible. Jobs requiring more than yoe_threshold+1 are excluded.
